elements.justification: "vehicles" is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ("every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway"), one atom, never expanded; "is prohibited or restricted in certain zones" introduces the restriction the yellow zone states.

Same words, same atoms as LVMC_11_52_030_A: st.curb_zone "a signed or marked length of curb; ... colour ... where the curb itself is painted", whose presence is the evidence that the zone was established (observable_reading status); rel.occupies ("a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)") anchors the subject in it.

"Yellow indicates a zone for" the uses listed: the subject occupies (rel.occupies) a st.curb_zone of colour yellow. Because the zone is for those uses only, any other halt in it (drv.motion.complete_halt, "at rest at the observation") is restricted. "stop" in the list has two posted definitions (DEF-NRS-484A-255, DEF-NRS-484A-260), each with its own scope. Both are a halting, and the halting is what the concept reads, so neither is chosen over the other.

"Commercial vehicles" is the admitted aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle ("a motor vehicle ... maintained or used primarily for the furtherance of a commercial enterprise"), one atom. It is never replaced by ru.commercial_motor_vehicle or ru.truck, which the definition's words do not equate with it. Under the ru.aggregate contract it is true only for a user that carries a class the run's reading includes. It is unknown where the user carries only unresolved classes, so the exception it carries is then unknown, never decided true and never dropped. "to stop, stand or park": its halt (drv.motion.complete_halt). "for the purpose of loading or unloading freight" is a purpose, read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose).

"an accompanying sign" is a dev.zone_sign of kind parking_restricted ("a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road; ... conditions attribute: a structured reading of the sign's legend — a list of time windows ..., a duration limit, a vehicle class"). It governs (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies): the lane beside the curb. "in accordance with the conditions and times posted" is prim.conditions_hold ("the structured conditions of a device ... hold at the observation for a road user") for the subject. The dev.zone_sign contract does not state whether the condition holds now; the primitive does.

"Taxicabs" is the admitted aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab ("a motor vehicle which is properly licensed under State and local law to provide taxicab service for a charge or fee"), one atom. It is never replaced by ru.taxicab, whose markings the definition's licensing words do not equate with it. Under the ru.aggregate contract it is unknown where the user carries only classes the run's reading leaves unresolved, so the exception it carries is then unknown. "to stop, stand, park": its halt (drv.motion.complete_halt). "for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers" is read through the halt it explains (observable_reading purpose).

Same words, same atoms as s5: a dev.zone_sign of kind parking_restricted governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies), with prim.conditions_hold for the subject.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle). At the judged observation, some region z of kind st.curb_zone whose colour is yellow has rel.occupies(subject, z). The duty does not apply under either exception. (1) The subject is a commercial vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-070::commercial_vehicle), and some dev.zone_sign d of kind parking_restricted governs (dev.governs) a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies), with prim.conditions_hold(d, subject). (2) The subject is a taxicab (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab), and such a sign's conditions hold for it. Each exception is a conjunction of the membership and the sign's conditions. Where the conditions are decided not to hold, the exception is false whatever the membership. Where they hold and membership is unknown under the run's reading, the exception is unknown.
obligation: The subject does not halt in z: not drv_motion_complete_halt(subject), with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance, judged at the observations where the applicability holds, so the halt judged is a halt in the yellow zone.

narrowings.why: The zones' establishment by sign, marking or paint is read through the presence of the signed or marked curb zone.

"a zone for" commercial vehicles and taxicabs is read as barring the halt of any other vehicle in the yellow zone. It also bars their own halt where the accompanying sign's conditions do not hold. A halt outside the sign's hours is read as outside the conditions posted.
"for the purpose of loading or unloading freight" is read through the commercial vehicle's halt; whether freight moves is not read.
The accompanying sign is read as a parking_restricted zone sign governing the lane beside the curb that the subject occupies. Its posting is the evidence of its force.
"for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers" is read through the taxicab's halt.
The accompanying sign is read as a parking_restricted zone sign governing the lane beside the curb that the subject occupies.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A curb zone z (st.curb_zone, colour yellow, kind freight_loading) has a zone sign d (dev.zone_sign kind parking_restricted, conditions: weekdays during business hours, class commercial motor vehicle) governing the parking lane beside it. A private passenger car (ru.motor_vehicle only) halts in z, at rest for several minutes on a weekday morning. The sign's conditions do not hold for it, so neither exception holds.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same car drives along z without halting.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The same car halts for several minutes in a curb zone whose colour is white.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source supplies no speed for the subject (kin.speed absent), so whether it halts is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A commercial delivery van (ru.motor_vehicle and ru.commercial_motor_vehicle) halts in z on a Sunday morning, outside the sign's time windows. The sign's conditions do not hold for it, so the commercial-vehicle exception is false whatever its membership.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab (ru.motor_vehicle and ru.taxicab) halts in z on a weekday morning. The sign's vehicle class is commercial motor vehicle, so its conditions do not hold for the taxicab, and the taxicab exception is false whatever its membership.
